options: Export value rose from 15 million in the 1850s to 38 million in the 1860s, an increase of 23 million.
Export value rose from 38 million in the 1860s to 44 million in the 1870s, a gain smaller than the one between the 1840s and the 1850s.
Export value was 12 million in the 1840s and 44 million in the 1870s, which means the largest single jump came in the final decade.
Export value rose from 15 million in the 1850s to 38 million in the 1860s, a gain of 13 million that was the same as the gain from the 1840s.
explanation: 1850년대(15)에서 1860년대(38)로의 증가는 23백만으로, 10년 단위 증가폭(3, 23, 6) 중 가장 커서 주장을 뒷받침하므로 A가 정답입니다. B는 1860~70년대 증가(6)가 1840~50년대 증가(3)보다 크므로 틀렸습니다. C는 마지막 10년의 증가가 6백만에 불과해 가장 큰 도약이 아니므로 틀렸습니다. D는 1850~60년대 증가를 13백만으로 잘못 제시했으며 실제로는 23백만이고, 1840년대의 증가는 3백만뿐입니다.
explanation_en: The 1850s-to-1860s change is 38 - 15 = 23 million, the largest of the three decade-to-decade changes (3, 23, 6), so A supports the claim. B is false: the 1860s-to-1870s gain (6) is larger than the 1840s-to-1850s gain (3). C is false: the final decade's gain of 6 million is the smallest-but-one, not the largest jump. D misstates the 1850s-1860s gain as 13 million; it is actually 23 million, and the 1840s gain was only 3 million.

options: Several Haarlem auctioneers began reporting that Semper Augustus bulbs had arrived in poor condition, even though contract prices for the variety had held steady until February.
Several regional growers began planting far larger quantities of Semper Augustus bulbs, which flooded the market and pushed contract prices down in the weeks before the failed auction.
Several regional guilds began circulating letters urging members to buy additional tulip contracts at the lower prices, even though the bulbs themselves were scarcer than in earlier seasons.
Several regional guilds began circulating letters urging members to refuse to honor existing tulip contracts entirely, even though the bulbs themselves were unaffected in condition or quantity.
explanation: 길드가 구근 상태나 수량에 변화가 없는데도 계약 이행을 거부하도록 촉구했다는 것은 가격 폭락이 구매자 신뢰 붕괴 때문이라는 주장을 가장 직접적으로 뒷받침합니다. 나머지 선택지는 구근의 품질 저하, 공급 증가, 희소성 변화를 가정하는데, 이는 주장과 반대되거나 지문에서 공급과 재배 조건에 변화가 없었다고 한 내용과 모순됩니다.
explanation_en: Only the guild letters urging refusal of contracts while the bulbs were unchanged show that the crash came from collapsing confidence rather than from supply or quality. The other options point to bulb condition, increased supply, or scarcity, which are changes in the bulbs' scarcity or value and so would undercut the claim or are contradicted by the passage's statement that no supply or condition change was recorded.

options: "ridership on the affected routes rose substantially after the bus lanes opened, which they attributed to the improved reliability of bus schedules"
"the corridor in question already had lower bus ridership than the cities studied, and that a new general-purpose lane might relieve car congestion"
"average bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent within a year, even as car traffic in adjacent lanes increased slightly"
"adding a dedicated bus lane on a congested corridor would reduce average commute times more effectively than adding a general-purpose traffic lane"
explanation: 정답은 버스 전용차로를 도입한 도시들에서 버스 통행 시간이 최소 15% 줄었고 인접 차로의 자동차 교통량은 약간만 늘었다는 구체적 근거를 제시해 주장을 뒷받침합니다. A는 승객 수 증가와 그 원인(배차 신뢰성)을 말할 뿐 통행 시간을 자동차 차로 확대와 비교하지 않습니다. B는 비판자들의 반론이므로 주장을 예시하지 않고 오히려 약화시킵니다. D는 계획가들의 주장을 그대로 되풀이한 문장일 뿐 근거를 제공하지 못합니다.
explanation_en: The correct choice gives concrete evidence from cities with bus lanes: bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent while car traffic in adjacent lanes rose only slightly, which supports the claim that bus lanes improve commute times. Choice A describes rising ridership and its cause (schedule reliability), not commute times compared with car lanes. Choice B reports the critics' objections, so it undermines the claim rather than illustrating it. Choice D merely restates the planners' claim as an assertion and provides no evidence for it.

options: Towns with the fewest economic ties to outside regions retained over 80 percent of distinctive dialect features throughout the twenty-year study period.
Towns with active community radio stations retained over 80 percent of distinctive dialect features even when they had extensive trade with outside regions.
Towns with strong storytelling traditions reported that older residents were more likely than younger residents to describe their speech as distinctive.
Towns with extensive trade with outside regions lost a larger share of their distinctive dialect features than towns with active radio stations did in the first decade.
explanation: 주장은 경제적 고립이 아니라 지역 기관이 방언 존속을 좌우한다는 것이므로, 외부와 교역이 활발해도 기관이 있는 마을이 방언을 유지했다는 B가 가장 적절한 근거입니다. A는 오히려 경쟁 관점인 고립설을 뒷받침합니다. C는 고립된 마을에서만 기관의 효과가 없었다는 내용으로 기관이 원인임을 보여 주지 못합니다. D는 방언 유지율이 아니라 연령별 자기 인식에 관한 것이라 논점에서 벗어나며, E는 경제적 접촉을 통제하지 않아 기관의 효과를 입증하지 못합니다.
explanation_en: The claim is that institutions, not isolation, determine dialect survival, so the best evidence shows institution-supported towns keeping their dialect despite heavy outside contact (B). A supports the competing isolation view. C shows only that institutions made no difference among isolated towns and says nothing about connected towns, so it does not isolate institutions as the cause. D concerns residents' self-description by age rather than dialect retention rates, so it is off-point. E compares trade-heavy towns to radio towns in a way that does not show institutions overriding connectedness, since it does not hold economic contact constant.

options: The labeled nitrogen isotope from digested insects remained concentrated in the pitchers themselves for several weeks.
The fluid stored in the pitcher-shaped leaves persisted at high volume through the driest weeks of the season.
The rare nitrogen isotope from the labeled insects appeared at similar levels in nearby non-carnivorous swamp plants within ten days.
The labeled nitrogen isotope from digested insects appeared at elevated levels in leaves far from the pitchers within ten days.
explanation: 정답은 소화된 곤충의 질소가 식물의 먼 잎까지 이동해 새 조직에 쓰였음을 보여 주므로 질소 포획 가설을 직접 뒷받침합니다. 첫 번째 오답은 동위원소가 포충낭에만 머물렀다고 하여 오히려 질소가 식물 전체로 이용된다는 주장과 어긋납니다. 두 번째 오답은 건기에 물이 유지된다는 내용으로 빗물 저장 가설에 해당합니다. 세 번째 오답은 다른 식물에 관한 내용이라 포충낭 잎의 진화 이유와 무관합니다.
explanation_en: Only the correct option shows that nitrogen from digested insects was transported and used by the plant's other tissues, which directly supports the nitrogen-capture claim. The first distractor says the isotope stayed in the pitchers, which would undermine the claim of incorporation into growth. The second describes water retention during drought, which supports the rainwater hypothesis instead. The third concerns other plants, which says nothing about why pitcher-shaped leaves evolved in pitcher plants.

options: Contracts from the period show that painters frequently proposed specific perspective techniques to patrons and described similar geometric methods in detail.
Contracts from the period show that patrons frequently referenced specific well-known paintings and asked for similar 'modern' spatial effects.
Correspondence from the period shows that patrons frequently praised the emotional impact of well-known paintings and rarely mentioned their spatial effects.
Contracts from the period show that patrons frequently specified costly pigments and asked for similar gilded surfaces in their commissions.
explanation: 이 주장은 원근법의 확산이 화가의 독자적 이해가 아니라 후원자의 수요 때문이었다는 것입니다. 후원자들이 유명 작품을 언급하며 비슷한 '현대적' 공간 효과를 요구했다는 B만이 이를 직접 뒷받침합니다. A는 화가가 먼저 기법을 제안했다는 내용이라 오히려 화가 주도설을 지지합니다. C는 후원자가 작품의 감정적 효과만 언급하고 공간 효과는 거의 언급하지 않았다는 내용이라 원근법 수요의 증거가 되지 못합니다. D는 안료와 금박 같은 재료 요구에 관한 것이라 원근법과 무관합니다.
explanation_en: The claim is that patron demand, not artists' independent understanding, drove the spread of perspective. Only B shows patrons explicitly requesting perspective-like effects by pointing to celebrated works. A shows painters, not patrons, introducing the techniques, which supports the artist-driven account. C shows patrons discussing paintings but not spatial effects, so it gives no evidence of demand for perspective. D shows patrons requesting materials rather than perspective techniques, which is off-point.

options: Critics see SESC Pompéia as a model for reusing industrial sites because Bo Bardi preserved the old factory's brick sheds and opened them for exhibitions, a library, and workshops rather than tearing them down.

Critics see SESC Pompéia as a model for adding new construction to industrial sites because Bo Bardi built three concrete towers with sports courts and a pool, joined by walkways crossing the site at upper levels.

Critics see SESC Pompéia as a landmark of Brazilian architecture because Bo Bardi, an Italian-born architect, began converting the former oil-drum factory in São Paulo in 1977 into a public leisure and cultural center.

Critics see SESC Pompéia as a model for combining recreation with culture because Bo Bardi placed sports courts and a swimming pool in the towers while housing exhibitions, a library, and workshops in the old sheds.
explanation: 목표는 비평가들이 이 프로젝트를 산업 건물 재사용의 모범으로 보는 이유를 설명하는 것입니다. 정답만이 벽돌 건물을 철거하지 않고 보존해 활용했다는 점을 비평가의 평가와 연결합니다. B는 새로 지은 콘크리트 탑을 강조해 재사용과 거리가 멉니다. C는 착공 연도, 위치, 건축가 출신 같은 배경 정보일 뿐 비평의 이유를 설명하지 않습니다. D는 시설 구성을 나열할 뿐, 노트에서 비평가들이 칭찬하는 근거로 제시한 내용이 아니며 재사용이라는 핵심 이유를 담지 않습니다.
explanation_en: The goal is to explain why critics see the project as a model for reusing industrial buildings. Only the key links the critics' view to preservation of the brick sheds instead of demolition. B emphasizes the new towers, which are additions rather than reuse. C gives background facts (date, location, architect's origin) that do not explain the critics' view. D describes the program of uses, which the notes never cite as the basis for critics' praise, and it omits the reuse rationale.

options: In Rivergate, the number of bicycle commuters per 1,000 residents rose from 18 before completion to 42 after completion, an increase of 24, while in Cedar Hollow it rose from 30 to only 33, an increase of just 3.

In Millbrook, the number of bicycle commuters per 1,000 residents rose from 25 before completion to 31 after completion, an increase of 6, and this gain was larger than the increase of 17 that Fenwick recorded across the same period.

In Fenwick, the number of bicycle commuters per 1,000 residents rose from 12 before completion to 29 after completion, an increase of 17, which matches the increase recorded in Millbrook, where the figure climbed from 25 to 42.

In Cedar Hollow, the number of bicycle commuters per 1,000 residents rose from 30 before completion to 33 after completion, so the city with the highest starting figure also posted the largest increase among the four cities studied.
explanation: 정답은 리버게이트의 증가폭(24)과 시더할로의 증가폭(3)을 대비해 도시별 증가가 균일하지 않음을 보여 줍니다. B는 밀브룩의 증가폭 6이 펜윅의 17보다 작으므로 틀립니다. C는 밀브룩이 25에서 31로 늘었을 뿐 42가 아니며 증가폭도 6이므로 틀립니다. D는 시더할로의 증가폭이 가장 작았으므로 가장 크다는 진술이 틀립니다.
explanation_en: The key contrasts a large increase in Rivergate (24) with a very small one in Cedar Hollow (3), which shows non-uniform gains. Choice B is wrong because Millbrook's gain of 6 is smaller than Fenwick's 17. Choice C is wrong because Millbrook rose from 25 to 31, not 42, so its increase was 6, not 17. Choice D is wrong because Cedar Hollow had the smallest increase, not the largest.

options: Radial Velocity, with a Year 1-5 count of 620 confirmed exoplanets
Transit Photometry, having produced 1,450 detections during the first five years
Microlensing, with a Year 6-10 count of 140 confirmed exoplanets
Transit Photometry, with a ten-year total of 3,550 confirmed exoplanets
explanation: 두 기간을 합산하면 Transit Photometry가 1,450 + 2,100 = 3,550으로 가장 큽니다. Radial Velocity의 620과 Microlensing의 140은 특정 기간 값일 뿐 총합이 아니며 총합도 더 작습니다. Transit Photometry의 1,450은 처음 5년 값일 뿐 10년 총합이 아닙니다.
explanation_en: Adding both periods gives Transit Photometry 1,450 + 2,100 = 3,550, the largest total. Radial Velocity's 620 and Microlensing's 140 are single-period values for methods with smaller totals, and 1,450 is only Transit Photometry's first-period count, not its ten-year total.

options: Average bus commute times fell by 22 percent, while average drive times on the three parallel side streets rose by less than 3 percent.
Bus riders saved an average of nine minutes per trip once the lane opened, though side-street motorists lost roughly eleven percent more time during evening peak hours.
Surveyed riders described their commutes as somewhat more pleasant after the conversion, and a majority said they would recommend the new service to coworkers and neighbors.
Average drive times for motorists on the corridor itself dropped by about a tenth after conversion, a shift the agency linked to fewer vehicles entering downtown overall.
explanation: 정답 A는 버스 통근 시간이 22% 줄고 병행 이면도로 운전 시간은 3% 미만으로만 늘었다는 수치를 함께 제시하여 '운전자 여건을 크게 악화시키지 않으면서 전체 통근 시간을 개선한다'는 주장의 두 부분을 모두 뒷받침합니다. B는 이면도로 운전자의 시간이 약 11% 더 늘었다고 하여 주장과 모순됩니다. C는 인식 조사일 뿐 운전자나 통근 시간에 대한 자료가 아닙니다. D는 간선도로 운전자만 다루고 버스 이용자와 이면도로 증거가 없어 주장 전체를 입증하지 못합니다.
explanation_en: A is the only quotation that shows a large commute-time gain for bus riders and only a negligible (under 3 percent) increase for side-street drivers, supporting both parts of the claim. B reports an 11 percent rise in side-street driving time, which contradicts 'without significantly worsening conditions'. C offers only perceived satisfaction, not commute-time data about drivers. D covers corridor drivers only and gives no bus or side-street evidence, so it cannot support the full claim.

options: the star's magnitude was 3.9 on both Day 1 and Day 12, the opening and closing readings, showing that the cycle ended exactly where it began.
the star's magnitude was 3.2 on Day 3, its brightest recorded point, compared with a magnitude of 5.1 on Day 9, its dimmest recorded point.
the star's magnitude fell from 4.5 on Day 5 to 4.0 on Day 6, a difference of only 0.5 between two consecutive observation days.
the star was dimmer on Day 3 than on Day 9, with readings of 5.1 and 3.2 respectively, indicating a pronounced shift across the cycle.
explanation: 정답은 가장 밝은 값(3일차 3.2)과 가장 어두운 값(9일차 5.1)을 비교해 1.9등급의 큰 변화를 보여 줍니다. A는 1일차와 12일차가 모두 3.9로 변화가 없음을 보여 주므로 부적절합니다. C는 연속한 이틀(4.5와 4.0)의 작은 차이만 제시하여 '상당한 변화'를 뒷받침하지 못합니다. D는 값을 뒤바꿨으며, 등급이 낮을수록 밝으므로 3일차(3.2)가 9일차(5.1)보다 밝아 사실과 다릅니다.
explanation_en: The key cites the brightest (3.2 on Day 3) and dimmest (5.1 on Day 9) readings, showing a 1.9-magnitude range. Choice A compares Day 1 and Day 12, which are both 3.9 and show no change. Choice C compares consecutive days (4.5 and 4.0), a small difference that does not show substantial change. Choice D reverses the values: a lower magnitude means brighter, so Day 3 (3.2) was brighter than Day 9 (5.1), not dimmer.
failures: 독립 풀이 2(haiku)가 다른 답(A)을 고름

options: Site C, with a temperature anomaly of $1.8^\circ$C, had a bleaching percentage of 62 percent, while Site F, with a temperature anomaly of $0.6^\circ$C, had a bleaching percentage of only 18 percent.

Site C, which registered the largest anomaly of the six locations, showed bleaching 17 points above Site D, whose reading was $1.5^\circ$C, though that gap says nothing about the cooler locations in the study.

Site B, warmed by only $0.9^\circ$C, experienced 25 percent bleaching, whereas Site A, warmed by a smaller $0.8^\circ$C, experienced 35 percent bleaching, which is a reversal of the expected pattern between those neighbors.
Site E, at $1.2^\circ$C, recorded 40 percent bleaching, and Site D, at $1.5^\circ$C, recorded 45 percent bleaching, so these two middle sites differed by just five points in bleaching severity.
explanation: 정답은 이상 고온이 가장 큰 C(1.8°C, 62%)와 가장 작은 F(0.6°C, 18%)를 대비해 수온 이상이 클수록 백화가 심하다는 경향을 보여 줍니다. 한 오답은 C와 D만 비교해 범위 전체를 보여 주지 못합니다. 다른 오답은 A와 B를 제시하는데, 이는 경향에 어긋나는 예외입니다. 나머지 오답은 중간 지점인 E와 D만 비교해 양 극단의 대비를 드러내지 못합니다.
explanation_en: The key contrasts the highest-anomaly site (C: 1.8°C, 62%) with the lowest-anomaly site (F: 0.6°C, 18%), showing that more warming goes with more bleaching. One distractor compares C only with D, a narrow gap that does not span the range. Another cites A and B, a true pair that is an exception to the trend. The last compares the two middle sites E and D, which does not illustrate the extremes.

options: Planet Y completes one orbit in 92 Earth days, which is less than half the 210 Earth days that Planet Z needs to finish its circuit
Planet W completes one orbit in 18 Earth days, which is quicker than the 45 Earth days Planet X requires, so the star hosts fast planets
Planet W completes one orbit in 18 Earth days, while Planet Y takes 92 Earth days to complete one orbit
Planet Z completes one orbit in 210 Earth days, which is far longer than the 45 Earth days Planet X needs to go around
explanation: 주장은 행성 Y가 행성 W보다 공전 시간이 길다는 것이므로, W의 18일과 Y의 92일을 함께 제시한 선택지가 정답입니다. 나머지 선택지는 표의 실제 수치를 쓰지만 Y와 Z, W와 X, Z와 X처럼 다른 쌍을 비교하고 있어 주장을 뒷받침하지 못합니다. 따라서 W와 Y를 직접 비교한 선택지만 알맞습니다.
explanation_en: The claim compares Planet Y with Planet W, so the correct choice must cite the periods of exactly those two planets: 18 days for W and 92 days for Y. The other options cite real values but compare different pairs (Y with Z, W with X, Z with X), so none of them shows that Y takes longer than W.

options: Painter C has 12 surviving attributed paintings, while Painter A holds 65, the largest total in the table
Painter D has 34 surviving attributed paintings, roughly half of Painter A's 65, making D the least represented painter
Painter B has 48 surviving attributed paintings, a figure that is 14 higher than the count for Painter D
Painter C has only 12 surviving attributed paintings, fewer than any of the other three painters
explanation: 주장은 화가 C의 현존 작품 수(12점)가 네 명 중 가장 적다는 것입니다. D는 C의 12점이 나머지 세 화가보다 적다는 점을 직접 보여 줍니다. 다른 선택지는 표의 실제 수치(65, 34, 48)를 쓰지만 가장 많은 총계를 강조하거나, D를 가장 적은 화가로 잘못 말하거나, B와 D만 비교하므로 C가 가장 적다는 주장을 뒷받침하지 못합니다.
explanation_en: The claim is that Painter C has the fewest paintings, so the evidence must show C's total of 12 is lower than every other painter's. Choice D does this. The other options cite real values (65, 34, 48) but either highlight the largest total, wrongly call Painter D the least represented, or compare B and D, none of which supports the claim about C.
failures: 블라인드 재검사에서 여전히 2회 high 로 정답을 맞힘

options: At a soil moisture level of 10%, germination rate was 22%, and it climbed to 41% at 20% and then to 63% at 30%, showing steady gains across the lower moisture range.
At a soil moisture level of 40%, germination rate reached its highest value, 74%, but at 50% it fell to 58% and at 60% it fell further to 39%.
